summary: Shell plc furnished a Form 6-K, the US equivalent of a foreign private issuer current report, disclosing UK/EU Market Abuse Regulation transactions by Chief Legal Officer Philippa Bounds and persons closely associated with her. The filing covers periodic Dividend Reinvestment Scheme purchases of 1,387 ordinary shares totaling GBP 41,028.76 across dates from June 2024 through September 2026 at prices of roughly GBP 23.96–35.395 on the London exchange. Bounds and her PCAs will cancel DRIP elections at the next opportunity to avoid further small-trade notifications. No board recommendation, advisor, stake, premium, or deal terms are stated; no risk-arb angle applies.
